claims.assertion: Mari says Earth’s “veil of forgetting” results from frequency incompatibility and claims controllers exploit it to manipulate people and historical memory.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says societies that remember past lives may be calmer but tend toward social and technological stasis until new threats spur development.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She cites Taygetan starship development as an example.

claims.assertion: Mari says past-life memories vary, can shape present values and personality, and may be set aside when someone chooses a new identity.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as her own choice.

coverage_gaps: Other claims about memory’s burdens and benefits omitted
